images.prompt: Natural product photograph of one plain matte charcoal bicycle helmet on a dark gray table. Five elongated ventilation slots are visible across its curved upper shell, and one black chin strap lies loosely in front. Soft broad daylight from upper left, dark neutral background, three-quarter camera, full helmet and strap visible. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Complete composition with breathing room. Natural photography and realistic light; no text, logo, watermark, or existing graphic treatment.

review.reason: One complete neutral-gray bicycle helmet sits on a dark tabletop. Six visible ventilation openings, foam interiors and the connected chin-strap assembly with adjusters and clasp are clearly readable. The full object and strap remain within frame, with natural soft light and no logo, lettering or pre-existing spectral graphic.

images.actual_source_analysis: One matte charcoal bicycle helmet sits on a dark gray table in three-quarter view. Six ventilation openings are visible on its curved shell: two shallow openings along the upper crown and four longer openings across the nearer upper/front surface, including the narrow far-right slot. Dark foam is visible inside them. One connected black chin-strap assembly descends at both sides and forms a loose loop in front, with two side adjusters and one clipped buckle near lower right. The whole helmet and strap are inside the frame. Broad light from the upper left creates a neutral soft highlight while the background remains dark.
